people.name: Valeria Lukyanova
people.extract: Valeria Valeryevna Lukyanova is a Ukrainian model best known for her resemblance to a Barbie doll. She currently has property in Mexico and lives in Moscow. To enhance the Barbie effect Lukyanova uses makeup and contact lenses over her naturally green/gray/blue eyes. She has stated that she has had breast implants, but that the rest of her body is natural and slender due to daily gym workouts and a particular diet.
highlights: Ukrainian model known for Barbie doll resemblance.
Uses makeup and contact lenses for Barbie effect.
Stated she has had breast implants.

people.name: Peter Thomson (golfer)
people.extract: Peter William Thomson was an Australian professional golfer, often cited as the greatest and most successful golfer in Australian golf history. In the late 1940s, Thomson turned professional and immediately had success on the Australasian circuits, then posted his first international win at the 1950 New Zealand Open followed by the 1951 Australian Open.
highlights: Greatest and most successful golfer in Australian history.
